pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The patches exhibit irregular, primarily polygonal geometries with rounded vertices. Edge gradients are diffuse rather than sharp. Relative spatial area is heterogeneous, with smaller, more condensed patches on the upper neck transition and larger, more expansive patches across the lateral flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-pigmented pathways forms a tessellated grid. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent and tetravalent. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank, maintaining structural continuity without significant bottlenecks or expansions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette. The serration is densely packed with minimal variation in peak height against the background.
